question.text: What is non-signaling tester, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

exchange.sent: What is non-signaling tester, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

answer.answer:
## Short answer
A non-signaling tester is a tester used for **non-signaling RF measurements**, especially in production, where WLAN device RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time; in the R&S Wi‑Fi 7 production context, the R&S CMP180 is positioned as the production non-signaling RF measurement tester optimized for that purpose [6][7].  
## Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Whether the task is **production RF measurement** or **R&D signaling / real-world operation testing** | CMP180 covers production non-signaling RF testing, while CMX500 covers R&D signaling / interworking testing in the Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production workflow [5]. |
| Whether to choose **CMP180** or **CMX500** for Wi‑Fi 7 work | CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester for R&D signaling-mode Wi‑Fi 7 testing, while CMP180 is described as the production non-signaling RF measurement tester [4][7]. |
| Whether the measurement category is **Non-signaling RF**, **Signaling Protocol**, or **Pre-conformance** | The raw source separates “Non-signaling - RF,” “Signaling - Protocol,” and “Pre-conformance” as different measurement categories [100]. |
| Whether production testing needs CMP180 RF capability for **Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz** | The CMP180 production non-signaling RF tester is stated to support cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [6][7]. |
| Whether a CMP180 setup must support **480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback** | CMP180 is stated to demonstrate loopback-mode verification of a 480 MHz bandwidth WLAN waveform, described as a potential candidate waveform for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn rather than a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [6][7]. |
| Whether CMP180 hardware must support **2x2 MIMO or 4x4 MIMO access point testing** | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined to support four analyzers and generators for efficient 4x4 MIMO access point testing [6][7]. |
| Whether to configure CMP180 RF units for **250 MHz or 500 MHz bandwidth** | CMP180 RF unit R&S CMP-B802x supports 250 MHz bandwidth, while R&S CMP-B805x supports 250 MHz bandwidth and can enable 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 [41]. |
| Whether a second CMP180 RF generator/analyzer path is needed | CMP180 has RF generator/analyzer no. 1 with 8 × SnapN ports, and RF generator/analyzer no. 2 with 8 × SnapN ports requires R&S CMP-K102 or R&S CMP-K105 software license key [41]. |
| Which CMP180 waveform options may be relevant for non-signaling production-style waveform generation or playback | CMP180 supports waveform creator, standard-specific waveform playback, and predefined waveform options including non-cellular, cellular, GPRF, GNSS, NB-IoT, LP-IoT, UWB, Bluetooth, WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, GSM, WCDMA, CDMA2000, LTE, LTE C‑V2X, NR Rel. 15/16, NR Rel. 17, and NR C‑V2X [43]. |
| Whether CMX500 signaling options are needed instead of CMP180 non-signaling production testing | CMX500 provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO, while CMP180’s cited role in the Wi‑Fi 7 production context is non-signaling RF measurement [13][6]. |
| Whether application, protocol, IP, or voice-quality testing is in scope | CMX500 supports application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, scripting, and protocol-related capabilities, whereas CMP180 is positioned in the cited Wi‑Fi 7 production context for non-signaling RF measurement [13][55][6]. |
| Whether to treat PR claims as formal specifications | The Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production source is identified as PR / demonstration positioning rather than a formal datasheet, configuration guide, test case list, or certification document, so CMP180 480 MHz waveform status, measurement specifications, and production throughput cannot be inferred from it [45]. |

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

Signaling test solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。
- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的單一技術 signaling test。
- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。
- 來源指出如果 UAV 使用兩種以上通訊技術，通訊技術之間可能造成相互干擾；基於 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。
- 來源對多技術整合驗證的配置原則是：software options 合併上述 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 來源末尾列出兩個待讀材料：本機 PDF `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf`，以及 SharePoint 上 `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`；正文未擷取。

Signaling test solution › UAV 與通訊技術
- [[UAV 通訊]] — 本來源補充 UAV 產品使用 Radio、Wi‑Fi、LTE、5G、SATCOM、RTK 與 proprietary radio 的例子。
- [[UAV 通訊頻段]] — 本來源新增 DJI O4 / O3+ 專有影像傳輸使用 2.4 / 5.8 GHz 的例子；頻段合規仍需回到地區法規與產品文件確認。

- [[UAV 多技術 De-sense 驗證]] — 來源中的多技術整合驗證線索；目前只有概念性配置原則，未提供 test case、limits 或量測結果。
- [[Radio communication]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[SATCOM]]、[[RTK]]、[[MIMO]]、[[EVM]]、[[PER]]、[[BLER]]。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMW270 › Wireless connectivity 相關章節摘錄
來源把 [[R&S CMW270]] 定義為 Wireless connectivity tester；摘錄中未對每一個 wireless connectivity 章節逐一標示 [[R&S CMW270]] 適用性，因此下列為來源中的技術章節與 option code 摘錄，不推論未明示的適用範圍。

| Bluetooth analyzer | R&S®CMW-KM610 / KM611 / KM721 | Bluetooth BR/EDR、RF PHY Test Reference Packets、LE 2 Msymbol/s / LE long range analyzer options |
| Bluetooth signaling | R&S®CMW-KS600 / KS610 / KS611 / KS721 / KS601 | Bluetooth signaling prerequisites；R&S®CMW-B200A also listed |

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 可追溯範圍與限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。
- 本頁不推論 [[Bluetest RTS65]]、其他 Bluetest RTS chambers 或 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的完整規格、measurement uncertainty、校準流程或 certification applicability。
- 本頁不把新聞稿中的 solution positioning 視為 conformance test coverage 或正式規格。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap › 重點摘要
- [[EMITE]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 繼續合作，enhance [[EMITE]] 的 [[OTA testing]] measurement solutions。
- 合作內容是 fully integrating the latest test capabilities of [[R&S CMX500]] multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- 來源稱整合後除了支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]] 與 [[NR FR2]]，也支援 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 cellular technologies，包括 [[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz，以及 latest [[5G RedCap]] technology。
- 同一來源也說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 non-cellular technologies，包括 latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- 對 [[EMITE]] customers 的價值是取得 comprehensive environment，用於 accurately assessing the performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] devices。
- 下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] 與 [[NR NTN]]；來源稱這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源用背景段落說明 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 具 tens of gigabits per second、low latency，面向 ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality。
- 來源定義 [[RedCap]] 為 [[3GPP Release 17]] 的 5G technology，是 reduced-functionality version of 5G，相較 [[5G eMBB]] 成本顯著較低，具 mid-range data throughput、low power consumption、low complexity 與支援大量 devices 的能力，特別適合 [[IoT]] applications。
- [[David A. Sánchez-Hernández]] 以 [[EMITE]] CEO 身分表示，EMITE 將 testing chambers 升級到搭配 [[R&S CMX500]]，使 customers 可 extend capabilities to include [[IEEE 802.11be]] standard 與 Red Cap devices。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 整合進 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers portfolio，可支援 latest technologies 的 reliability 與 efficiency 測試。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing
[[CMX500 use-case based 5G testing]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 market / solution positioning：以 use-case based approach 支援 5G eMBB、FWA、RedCap、NTN、XR 等裝置測試，而不只是一組單點工具。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。
- Conformance：LTE、NR、2G、3G、C-IoT。
- 測試範圍：RF Conformance、RRM、LBS、NetOp、PCT、signaling tests、application、callbox、NPT、PQA、3GPP RF preconformance、ATE。
- 相關設備：[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]]、[[R&S NGM200]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › XR / application testing 線索
來源的 XR / Metaverse 章節以 [[R&S CMX500]] 連接 lab-based XR testbed：

- Compact 3GPP-compliant OTA chamber for 5G NR mmWave signals。
- 5G One Box Signaling Tester。
- Cloud XR Server。
- IP connection。
- XR Client App。
- Artificial Head on 3D positioner to emulate 6DoF。
- HMD or AR glasses。
- USB-C tethering。
- future: WiFi7。

來源另列 R&S CMX500 XR-related roadmap focuses on power savings and low latency，包含 BWP switching、SCell dormancy、cross-slot scheduling、uplink configured grant、enhanced cDRX、PDCCH skipping、low latency mobility 等 Release 15–18 / 19 features。此部分本次只作為待拆頁線索。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

R&S CMP180 › Transmitter test functions
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1。
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）tables for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 的 RF unit 描述：

- **R&S CMP-B802x**：僅支援 **250 MHz bandwidth**。
- **R&S CMP-B805x**：支援 **250 MHz bandwidth**，可用 **R&S CMP-K185** 啟用 **500 MHz**。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：

- RF generator/analyzer no. 1：**8 × SnapN**，RF input/output to DUT，RF 1.1 to RF 1.8。
- RF generator/analyzer no. 2：**8 × SnapN**，RF input/output to DUT，RF 2.1 to RF 2.8；requires **R&S CMP-K102** or **R&S CMP-K105** software license key。

R&S CMP180 › Receiver test functions
- RF generator signal is split and forwarded to 8 output ports each。
- every output can be switched off separately。
- collective output level setting for connectors RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 and RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）table for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

R&S CMP180 › Waveform 與 R&S WinIQSIM2 options
依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，CMP180 支援 waveform creator、standard-specific waveform playback 與 [[R&S VSE]] analysis options。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] ordering information，software predefined waveform options 包括：

- Non-cellular waveforms for ARB generator pack 1：R&S CMP-PKV30，1212.3708.02。
- Cellular waveforms for ARB generator pack 1：R&S CMP-PKV40，1212.3714.02。
- GPRF waveforms：R&S CMP-KV210，1212.4427.02。
- GNSS waveforms：R&S CMP-KV220，1212.2330.02。
- NB-IoT waveforms：R&S CMP-KV250，1212.2347.02。
- LP-IoT waveforms, Zigbee / SigFox：R&S CMP-KV280，1212.2353.02。
- UWB production waveforms：R&S CMP-KV305，1212.4327.02。
- NG-UWB production waveforms：R&S CMP-KV306，1212.4704.02。
- Bluetooth waveforms / HDT Rel. 7.0：R&S CMP-KV310 / R&S CMP-KV317。
- WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be：R&S CMP-KV350 / K-V351 / K-V352。
- GSM、WCDMA、CDMA2000、LTE、LTE C-V2X、NR Rel. 15/16、NR Rel. 17、NR C-V2X。

[[R&S WinIQSIM2]] waveform options include waveform creator **R&S CMP-KW101** and AWGN / GNSS / NB-IoT / LP-IoT / Bluetooth / WLAN / GSM / WCDMA / CDMA2000 / LTE / NR waveform options.

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[R&S CMX500]] 頁已依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 記錄 CMX500 的 WLAN signaling / measurement options；本來源補充的是 2024 MWC PR / solution demonstration 語境，不提供正式 option code、software version 或硬體 BOM。
- 既有 [[R&S CMP180]] 頁已依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] 記錄 8 GHz frequency extension 與 500 MHz bandwidth options；本來源補充 MWC 2024 對 Wi‑Fi 7 production testing 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback demonstration 的 positioning。
- 既有 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 主要來自 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR；本來源不描述 OTA chamber，而是 R&S own CMX500 / CMP180 single-box R&D / production workflow。
- 既有 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 頁依較晚的 R&S / Broadcom PR 記錄 Wi-Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth；本來源較早期說 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，且 480 MHz waveform 是 potential candidate，因此需在 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 並列而不調和。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

| [[R&S CMXmars]] | Message log analysis，可離線分析或在線監控 instrument messaging |
| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |
| [[SCPI]] | Remote control interface，適合 simple、standardized scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

R&S CMX500 › Spectrum analysis
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM140 提供 spectrum analysis options，包含 frequency sweep measurement（power vs frequency）與 zero span measurement（power vs time）。General settings 包含 external attenuation **-50 dB 至 90 dB**、sweep count **1 至 100**、sweep points **101 至 100001**；frequency sweep RBW **100 Hz 至 10 MHz**，VBW **10 Hz 至 10 MHz**。

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 另提供 FFT spectrum analyzer span 與 FFT length，詳見 ARB 與 FFT spectrum analyzer 章節。

## Short answer
A non-signaling tester is a tester used for **non-signaling RF measurements**, especially in production, where WLAN device RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time; in the R&S Wi‑Fi 7 production context, the R&S CMP180 is positioned as the production non-signaling RF measurement tester optimized for that purpose [6][7].  
## Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Whether the task is **production RF measurement** or **R&D signaling / real-world operation testing** | CMP180 covers production non-signaling RF testing, while CMX500 covers R&D signaling / interworking testing in the Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production workflow [5]. |
| Whether to choose **CMP180** or **CMX500** for Wi‑Fi 7 work | CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester for R&D signaling-mode Wi‑Fi 7 testing, while CMP180 is described as the production non-signaling RF measurement tester [4][7]. |
| Whether the measurement category is **Non-signaling RF**, **Signaling Protocol**, or **Pre-conformance** | The raw source separates “Non-signaling - RF,” “Signaling - Protocol,” and “Pre-conformance” as different measurement categories [100]. |
| Whether production testing needs CMP180 RF capability for **Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz** | The CMP180 production non-signaling RF tester is stated to support cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [6][7]. |
| Whether a CMP180 setup must support **480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback** | CMP180 is stated to demonstrate loopback-mode verification of a 480 MHz bandwidth WLAN waveform, described as a potential candidate waveform for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn rather than a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [6][7]. |
| Whether CMP180 hardware must support **2x2 MIMO or 4x4 MIMO access point testing** | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined to support four analyzers and generators for efficient 4x4 MIMO access point testing [6][7]. |
| Whether to configure CMP180 RF units for **250 MHz or 500 MHz bandwidth** | CMP180 RF unit R&S CMP-B802x supports 250 MHz bandwidth, while R&S CMP-B805x supports 250 MHz bandwidth and can enable 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 [41]. |
| Whether a second CMP180 RF generator/analyzer path is needed | CMP180 has RF generator/analyzer no. 1 with 8 × SnapN ports, and RF generator/analyzer no. 2 with 8 × SnapN ports requires R&S CMP-K102 or R&S CMP-K105 software license key [41]. |
| Which CMP180 waveform options may be relevant for non-signaling production-style waveform generation or playback | CMP180 supports waveform creator, standard-specific waveform playback, and predefined waveform options including non-cellular, cellular, GPRF, GNSS, NB-IoT, LP-IoT, UWB, Bluetooth, WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, GSM, WCDMA, CDMA2000, LTE, LTE C‑V2X, NR Rel. 15/16, NR Rel. 17, and NR C‑V2X [43]. |
| Whether CMX500 signaling options are needed instead of CMP180 non-signaling production testing | CMX500 provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO, while CMP180’s cited role in the Wi‑Fi 7 production context is non-signaling RF measurement [13][6]. |
| Whether application, protocol, IP, or voice-quality testing is in scope | CMX500 supports application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, scripting, and protocol-related capabilities, whereas CMP180 is positioned in the cited Wi‑Fi 7 production context for non-signaling RF measurement [13][55][6]. |
| Whether to treat PR claims as formal specifications | The Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production source is identified as PR / demonstration positioning rather than a formal datasheet, configuration guide, test case list, or certification document, so CMP180 480 MHz waveform status, measurement specifications, and production throughput cannot be inferred from it [45]. |

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

Signaling test solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。

- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。

- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。

Signaling test solution › UAV 與通訊技術
- [[UAV 通訊]] — 本來源補充 UAV 產品使用 Radio、Wi‑Fi、LTE、5G、SATCOM、RTK 與 proprietary radio 的例子。

- [[Radio communication]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[SATCOM]]、[[RTK]]、[[MIMO]]、[[EVM]]、[[PER]]、[[BLER]]。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMW270 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。

- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 可追溯範圍與限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。
- 本頁不推論 [[Bluetest RTS65]]、其他 Bluetest RTS chambers 或 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的完整規格、measurement uncertainty、校準流程或 certification applicability。
- 本頁不把新聞稿中的 solution positioning 視為 conformance test coverage 或正式規格。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。

EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap › 重點摘要
- [[EMITE]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 繼續合作，enhance [[EMITE]] 的 [[OTA testing]] measurement solutions。
- 合作內容是 fully integrating the latest test capabilities of [[R&S CMX500]] multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- 來源稱整合後除了支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]] 與 [[NR FR2]]，也支援 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 cellular technologies，包括 [[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz，以及 latest [[5G RedCap]] technology。
- 同一來源也說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 non-cellular technologies，包括 latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- 對 [[EMITE]] customers 的價值是取得 comprehensive environment，用於 accurately assessing the performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] devices。
- 下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] 與 [[NR NTN]]；來源稱這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源用背景段落說明 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 具 tens of gigabits per second、low latency，面向 ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality。
- 來源定義 [[RedCap]] 為 [[3GPP Release 17]] 的 5G technology，是 reduced-functionality version of 5G，相較 [[5G eMBB]] 成本顯著較低，具 mid-range data throughput、low power consumption、low complexity 與支援大量 devices 的能力，特別適合 [[IoT]] applications。
- [[David A. Sánchez-Hernández]] 以 [[EMITE]] CEO 身分表示，EMITE 將 testing chambers 升級到搭配 [[R&S CMX500]]，使 customers 可 extend capabilities to include [[IEEE 802.11be]] standard 與 Red Cap devices。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 整合進 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers portfolio，可支援 latest technologies 的 reliability 與 efficiency 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

## Short answer
A non-signaling tester is a tester used for **non-signaling RF measurements**, especially in production, where WLAN device RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time; in the R&S Wi‑Fi 7 production context, the R&S CMP180 is positioned as the production non-signaling RF measurement tester optimized for that purpose [6][7].  
## Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Whether the task is **production RF measurement** or **R&D signaling / real-world operation testing** | CMP180 covers production non-signaling RF testing, while CMX500 covers R&D signaling / interworking testing in the Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production workflow [5]. |
| Whether to choose **CMP180** or **CMX500** for Wi‑Fi 7 work | CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester for R&D signaling-mode Wi‑Fi 7 testing, while CMP180 is described as the production non-signaling RF measurement tester [4][7]. |
| Whether the measurement category is **Non-signaling RF**, **Signaling Protocol**, or **Pre-conformance** | The raw source separates “Non-signaling - RF,” “Signaling - Protocol,” and “Pre-conformance” as different measurement categories [100]. |
| Whether production testing needs CMP180 RF capability for **Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz** | The CMP180 production non-signaling RF tester is stated to support cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [6][7]. |
| Whether a CMP180 setup must support **480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback** | CMP180 is stated to demonstrate loopback-mode verification of a 480 MHz bandwidth WLAN waveform, described as a potential candidate waveform for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn rather than a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [6][7]. |
| Whether CMP180 hardware must support **2x2 MIMO or 4x4 MIMO access point testing** | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined to support four analyzers and generators for efficient 4x4 MIMO access point testing [6][7]. |
| Whether to configure CMP180 RF units for **250 MHz or 500 MHz bandwidth** | CMP180 RF unit R&S CMP-B802x supports 250 MHz bandwidth, while R&S CMP-B805x supports 250 MHz bandwidth and can enable 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 [41]. |
| Whether a second CMP180 RF generator/analyzer path is needed | CMP180 has RF generator/analyzer no. 1 with 8 × SnapN ports, and RF generator/analyzer no. 2 with 8 × SnapN ports requires R&S CMP-K102 or R&S CMP-K105 software license key [41]. |
| Which CMP180 waveform options may be relevant for non-signaling production-style waveform generation or playback | CMP180 supports waveform creator, standard-specific waveform playback, and predefined waveform options including non-cellular, cellular, GPRF, GNSS, NB-IoT, LP-IoT, UWB, Bluetooth, WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, GSM, WCDMA, CDMA2000, LTE, LTE C‑V2X, NR Rel. 15/16, NR Rel. 17, and NR C‑V2X [43]. |
| Whether CMX500 signaling options are needed instead of CMP180 non-signaling production testing | CMX500 provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO, while CMP180’s cited role in the Wi‑Fi 7 production context is non-signaling RF measurement [13][6]. |
| Whether application, protocol, IP, or voice-quality testing is in scope | CMX500 supports application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, scripting, and protocol-related capabilities, whereas CMP180 is positioned in the cited Wi‑Fi 7 production context for non-signaling RF measurement [13][55][6]. |
| Whether to treat PR claims as formal specifications | The Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production source is identified as PR / demonstration positioning rather than a formal datasheet, configuration guide, test case list, or certification document, so CMP180 480 MHz waveform status, measurement specifications, and production throughput cannot be inferred from it [45]. |
